facts.fact: 音乐变调众人起身，Amrita 放下包转向两棵树形成的拱门。
facts.anchor: Quickly, Amrita put down her bag and stood too

facts.fact: Katie 走完通道，在尽头拥抱 Aiden 并替他整理领带。
facts.anchor: She paused at the end of the aisle, quickly hugged Aiden

facts.fact: 两个小花童被 Katie 一声口哨叫停，退回起点重新慢慢撒花瓣。
facts.anchor: The girls froze, giggled, and ran back to the start of the aisle

facts.fact: Mia 的裙摆由 Amrita 当天早上送去的披肩改造而成，白渐变到天蓝。
facts.anchor: a puffy skirt that Amrita wouldn’t have even guessed

facts.fact: Ophelia 把缀花彩绳覆在新人手上，触碰后泛出青铜光。
facts.anchor: She touched the ribbon within the cord, and it shimmered with bronze light

facts.fact: 戒指遍寻不着时，Lunar 穿林而来，把小绒袋丢进 Jamie 手里。
facts.anchor: Lunar zipped through the trees, scattering cherry blossoms

facts.fact: Mia 坦白原拟推迟婚礼，部分原因是 Jamie 与 Amrita 都心碎。
facts.anchor: Because one of the reasons Aiden and I had planned to delay was you.

facts.fact: 舞会后 Jamie 提出可离开 Hudsbury、请人封掉天赋。
